message.content: {"skills": [{"category": "diagnosis", "trigger": "When evaluating a chest X-ray showing multiple bilateral pulmonary nodules, particularly with peripheral distribution or early cavitation.", "steps": ["Check for the presence of multiple, bilateral, peripheral nodular opacities.", "Assess the nodules for signs of early cavitation (central lucency within the opacity).", "Distinguish from Tuberculosis by confirming the absence of predominant apical/upper lobe consolidation or fibrosis.", "Distinguish from Granulomatosis with polyangiitis by noting the lack of thick-walled, irregular cavities.", "Identify the pattern of peripheral, cavitating nodules as characteristic of septic pulmonary emboli."]}]}
